Question Choices: Convert the mixed number 1 2/3 into an improper fraction.
Hints: Each whole contains denominator-many fractional parts. Count them all; to reverse, divide numerator by denominator.
Solution: Each whole is 3/3. Convert 1 wholes to 3/3, then add 2/3: (1 x 3 + 2)/3 = 5/3. This counts 5 copies of 1/3. Check: 5 = 1 x 3 + 2.
